ui.noScript: The interactive diagram needs JavaScript. Flow summary:

whatsapp.title: Journey of one WhatsApp message
whatsapp.desc: From an incoming customer message to the reply being sent: duplicate check, spam check, conversation state, complaints, and escalation to staff.
names: Check if the message was already logged
Make sure holiday data is ready
Wait for the customer to finish typing
Check if the number is blocked
Send a welcome to a number cleared as not spam
Compose notice for a block candidate
Check whether the bot is paused
Check for requests outside the menu
Check numbers claiming to be staff
Need AI to read the name?
Pick the recipient staff from the database
Wait for the customer to type START
Ask how the customer found us

stages.title: Incoming message and duplicate check
stages.desc: The bot receives the WhatsApp message, reads its content, and makes sure the same message is not processed twice.

stages.title: Waiting for the customer to finish typing
stages.desc: The bot merges rapid-fire messages and only processes the latest one.

stages.title: Who is the sender?
stages.desc: The bot checks whether the sender is staff (including block commands) or a blocked number.

stages.title: Spam check and new customers
stages.desc: AI assesses the content of a new customer's message. Spam is stopped and the number is proposed for the block list.

stages.title: Conversation state
stages.desc: The bot builds the conversation state and checks whether staff is already handling it.

stages.title: Deciding the answer
stages.desc: The bot routes the message to the right menu and prepares the reply.

stages.title: Complaints and other requests
stages.desc: Messages outside the menu are logged as tickets, the email is sent, and the owner is notified.

stages.title: Notify staff when needed
stages.desc: If human help is needed, the bot composes a notice and sends a WhatsApp notification to staff.

stages.title: Store and log
stages.desc: Conversation history and decision logs are stored in the database.

stages.title: Reply to the customer
stages.desc: The bot waits a moment to feel natural, re-checks, then sends the reply.

scenarios.title: A normal message is answered by the bot
scenarios.desc: Main path: the message passes every check and is answered automatically.

scenarios.title: Duplicate message
scenarios.desc: WhatsApp sometimes delivers the same notification twice. The bot recognises it and stops right away.

scenarios.title: Spam message
scenarios.desc: AI judges the message as spam, the number is proposed for the block list, and the bot stays silent.

scenarios.title: Number already blocked
scenarios.desc: A number already on the block list is not answered at all.

scenarios.title: Message from staff
scenarios.desc: If the sender is staff, the bot ignores the message (except block commands).

scenarios.title: Staff is handling it
scenarios.desc: While staff hold the conversation, the bot stops and does not answer.

scenarios.title: Handed over to staff
scenarios.desc: The bot prepares a notice, staff are notified over WhatsApp, and the customer receives a reply.

scenarios.title: Complaint or other request
scenarios.desc: A message outside the menu becomes a complaint ticket, the email is sent, and the owner is notified.

staff.title: Staff commands and tickets
staff.desc: Staff manage tickets over WhatsApp: view the list, mark tickets resolved, or request and approve “resolve all”.
names: Check whether the sender is staff
Return the conversation to the menu

stages.title: Staff message arrives; role check
stages.desc: The bot receives the message, reads the staff list, and confirms the sender really is staff.

stages.title: Recognising the command
stages.desc: The bot works out whether staff asked for the menu, marked a ticket resolved, requested “resolve all”, or gave a decision.

stages.title: Marking a ticket resolved
stages.desc: The chosen ticket is marked resolved and the customer's conversation returns to the menu.

stages.title: Resolve all and approval
stages.desc: Staff request to resolve all tickets; the approver is notified and approves or rejects.

stages.title: Menu and ticket list
stages.desc: Staff see the ticket count, the list of open tickets, or a guide to resolving many tickets.

stages.title: Delay and reply
stages.desc: The bot waits a moment, shows “typing”, then sends the reply and logs it.

scenarios.title: Staff opens the ticket menu
scenarios.desc: Staff type MENU and receive options: total tickets, the open ticket list, or bulk resolution.

scenarios.title: Marking a ticket resolved
scenarios.desc: The ticket is marked resolved and the customer's conversation returns to the main menu.

scenarios.title: Requesting “resolve all”
scenarios.desc: Staff request resolution of all their tickets; the approver is notified to decide.

scenarios.title: The approver decides
scenarios.desc: The approver approves or rejects; the requester is told the result right away.

scenarios.title: Sender is not staff
scenarios.desc: Messages from numbers that are not staff are ignored.

health.title: System health monitor
health.desc: Every 15 minutes it checks for errors, scheduled workflows, and the WhatsApp session, then notifies recipients.

stages.title: Collecting checks
stages.desc: 13 steps from the schedule: list failed executions, check workflows and the messaging session, and read earlier alerts.

stages.title: Deciding and sending alerts
stages.desc: 12 steps: decide on alerts, store them, choose recipients, and send notifications.

scenarios.title: Up to the heartbeat message
scenarios.desc: Runs from the schedule to sending the heartbeat message.

scenarios.title: Up to the alert message
scenarios.desc: Runs from the schedule to sending an alert.

daily.title: Daily conversation report
daily.desc: Every morning: yesterday's numbers from the database, an AI analysis of the conversations, then the report goes to recipients.

stages.title: Counting the numbers
stages.desc: 7 steps from the schedule: set the dates, count yesterday's and the day-before metrics, count intents, and fetch transcripts.

stages.title: Analysis and delivery
stages.desc: 7 steps: build the AI prompt, analyse the chat, compose and store the report, choose recipients, and send it.

scenarios.title: From schedule to report
scenarios.desc: Runs from the schedule to delivering the report.

error.title: Error notifier
error.desc: Called when another workflow fails, then sends an alert.

stages.title: Notify when another workflow fails
stages.desc: 5 steps: build the error message, read recipient settings, choose recipients, and send the notification.

scenarios.title: From error to notification
scenarios.desc: Runs from the failed workflow to sending the notification.
